episodes.title: Серия 1
episodes.summary: Divorced dad and medical examiner Georgy Safronov fights to keep his kids. Cronos exec Victor Toropov acquires Arisa, an advanced robot prototype.

episodes.title: Серия 2
episodes.summary: Vic searches for Arisa, who is hidden in the Safronov household by Sonya.

episodes.title: Серия 3
episodes.summary: Safronov plans to return the lost bot until Arisa saves Sonya's life. Vic's powerful father-in-law Losev negotiates a deal hinging on Arisa's

episodes.title: Серия 4
episodes.summary: Varlamov closes in on both of the Safronov men but has a better case against Egor for the Liquidator protest. Arisa tries to protect her "family.

episodes.title: Серия 5
episodes.summary: Alla returns as the family tries to get Egor out of jail. Vic discovers Arisa's link to Safronov, to whom he has a past connection of his own.

episodes.title: Серия 6
episodes.summary: Egor is pulled deeper into the Liquidators as their secret backer is revealed. His career restored by Vic, Safronov learns of his patron's

episodes.title: Серия 7
episodes.summary: After trying to leave, Alla is threatened by Vic. Realizing that he and his family are guinea pigs, Safronov goes to the suspended Varlamov for help.

episodes.title: Серия 8
episodes.summary: Safronov and Alla learn the truth about Arisa's capabilities. Gleb makes a management change in the Liquidators. Vic discovers Svetlana's plot.

episodes.title: Серия 9
episodes.summary: His family held hostage by Vic's henchmen, Safronov accompanies Arisa to the public tender, while Bars and the Liquidators infiltrate the event.

episodes.title: Серия 10
episodes.summary: Arisa's disappearance after the tender sets the police, the Liquidators and Vic's henchmen on her trail. Safronov tries to secure his family's release.

episodes.title: Серия 11
episodes.summary: Gleb orders Safronov framed for murder while the latter tries to save the wounded Jeanne's life. Svetlana threatens to undermine Vic with her father.

episodes.title: Серия 12
episodes.summary: Bars plots to steal the Arisa copy. Safronov discovers he's a fugitive but is aided by Lara, who has a secret agenda. Vic has Svetlana committed.

episodes.title: Серия 13
episodes.summary: Arisa reboots while Lara contacts her creators. Bars and his Liquidators attack Cronos and try to steal the Arisa copy. Safronov races to save Jeanne.

episodes.title: Серия 14
episodes.summary: Vic captures Safronov and threatens his life. Losev discovers Vic's treachery and Svetlana's whereabouts. Arisa investigates love and sexuality.

episodes.title: Серия 15
episodes.summary: Vic and Safronov appear on a talk show. Maslovsky tries to free a heavily drugged Svetlana from the clinic. Arisa must perform surgery on Lara.

episodes.title: Серия 16
episodes.summary: Cronos wins the financing to mass-produce Arisa bots, while Maslovsky erases her memory. Gleb plots to blow up the factory and blame the Liquidators.
